[5:26PM] #Lekki #TrafficUpdate

Traffic from Ikate to the Car Wash area is flowing smoothly, with only a slight build-up at Car Wash due to alternating vehicular movement in and out of the corridor.

The stretch from Car Wash to the Dome on Freedom Way remains in good condition in both directions. Similarly, movement from the Dome to Zenith on Admiralty Way is steady and unhindered.

Traffic from Zenith to Tantalizer is progressing as expected in both directions, though there's a minor delay around the Tantalizer junction caused by traffic alternation.

However, there is a build-up on the Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge from Alexander Avenue, descending toward the roundabout, due to a high volume of vehicles and the presence of a speed breaker. Outbound movement on this route remains smooth.

The stretch from the Lekki Link Bridge roundabout to the Lekki Peninsula Scheme 1 Gate is clear, with both inward and outward traffic moving freely.

There are currently no reported impediments, and our personnel are visibly present and actively managing the situation.

data.raw_text:
[5:52PM] #VI #TrafficUpdate 

Movement from McWen Bridge both inward and outward towards Bonny Camp Roundabout remains smooth at this time. Inbound traffic on Ahmadu Bello Way en route Eko Hotel is busy but steady, largely due to closing hour rush, traffic light delays, and road alternations. The return leg from Eko Hotel toward Ahmadu Bello is also progressing well, with minor interruptions caused by traffic signal delays and alternation points.

Ahmadu Bello Way heading toward Bonny Camp is mostly clear, though there's a slight slowdown approaching the MRS fuel station and at the Adeola Odeku junction due to alternating traffic flow.

Traffic from Bonny Camp underbridge toward Kofo Abayomi is experiencing good movement. However, inward traffic toward Oniru and the Kilimanjaro area is a bit slow due to ongoing alternations. The route inward Akin Adesola, passing Law School and Civic Center, is busy but still moving, with some delays at alternation points.

Movement from Civic Center to BJ1004 is affected by alternating traffic flow and signal delays, causing some congestion. The stretch from BJ1004 through School Corner en route Sandfield to Lekki is progressing at a reasonable pace, with minor hold-ups at signal points.

The return journey from Lekki, through Sandfield, School Corner, BJ1004, Civic Center, and Akin Adesola to Law School is currently in good condition, aside from occasional delays due to alternating movement and functional traffic lights.

Traffic on Akin Adesola toward Kilimanjaro is steady, although slight delays are being experienced near Kilimanjaro junction due to traffic alternation and a pothole close to the intersection.

Finally, the route from Kilimanjaro to Kofo Abayomi, onward to McWen Bridge through Bonny Camp, is busy but moving, primarily due to the closing hour traffic buildup.

Our personnel are actively on ground managing the flow.

#FollowLASTMA
